newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mainly weaker on futures.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mainly weaker on futures.

text.p: NWE oil products were mainly weaker as futures waned, but premiums were firm on good demand.
Naphtha prices eased from the early highs as crude dipped back but premiums to quotes related contracts held steady, supported by good demand.
Gasoline prices eased in late trade, but tight Rotterdam supplies cushioned losses.
Gas oil ended lower as futures fell on profit-taking. Cargoe premiums remained firm on low stock concerns.
High sulphur cracked fuel oil barges ended the day slightly firmer from Friday's levels.
